extendedData.name: OracleText
extendedData.value:
We’ve partnered with AMC’s The Walking Dead to bring you one of the most exciting Secret Lair drops yet. It has five brand-new legends, each portraying one of our favorite TWD characters: Daryl, Glenn, Michonne, Negan, and Rick. These are unique cards you’ve never seen before, not reprints in any way, shape, or form. This drop also comes with five Zombie tokens, each an important walker from the show, and one Treasure token. We don’t plan on raising this drop back from the dead, so grab it now before we send it to rest.

NOTE: These are brand-new cards, not reprints or part of a main set. Therefore, they’re not legal in Standard, but they’re perfect for Commander!

Contents:
1x Foil Full-Art Daryl, Hunter of Walkers
1x Foil Full-Art Glenn, the Voice of Calm
1x Foil Full-Art Michonne, Ruthless Survivor
1x Foil Full-Art Negan, the Cold-Blooded
1x Foil Full-Art Rick, Steadfast Leader
5x Different Foil Walker Tokens
1x Foil Treasure Token

(Please note, the original print run of this Secret Lair, shipped by Wizards of the Coast, also contained 1x Foil Lucille.)
